title: How I Make $880/Day with AI Motion Design (Claude Motion)
fulltitle: How I Make $880/Day with AI Motion Design (Claude Motion)
description:
AI motion design with Claude: a $1,000 SaaS launch video built from code in one day, no After Effects. Then a real motion designer got the same brief.

🎬 Motion design skill, storyboard layout & proposal template: https://higgsfield.ai/s/sanji-chien-claude-motion-sanji_chien-LbpUcK 

You'll see the full workflow step by step: how to find high-paying SaaS and tech clients on Upwork even with an empty portfolio, the 4 checks to run before you spend Connects, and the exact cover letter that got 3 out of 5 clients to reply within hours. Then we build the product launch video in Claude Opus 5.5 with a custom motion design skill: a scene-by-scene storyboard, brand fonts and colors, and UI exported from Figma as SVG, rendered at 1920×1080 and 60 fps. You'll see the first broken render, the one-sentence prompts that fixed every bug, and why a storyboard makes or breaks AI motion graphics. Finally, the Claude version goes head to head with a $1,000 Fiverr motion designer, followed by the real profit breakdown: $880 kept from one day of work. Higgsfield AI is all about making real money with AI: the workflows, the prompts, and experiments like this one.
